entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: The 338-aa query matches reviewed homologs at 51–57% identity and ~99% coverage; inferred function is NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde (EC 1.2.1.11).

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde is a branch-point intermediate for lysine (DAP pathway), methionine, threonine, and homoserine biosynthesis.
